context.why: First story of FS-030, and the foundation every later story reads. Today fairdm.contrib.location has one model, Point (x, y as 5-place decimals, a crs label), shared by every sample and contributor at the same coordinates, with its own page at /location/<lon>/<lat>/. FairDM now runs on PostGIS with GeoDjango installed (#500). This story replaces Point with three fields on every Sample and Measurement (location PointField srid 4326, location_elevation, location_uncertainty) via an abstract LocatedRecord, moves the contributor's location to a PointField on Organization only, removes Point and everything around it, and builds the one location input (parse_coordinate on lat-lon-parser, LocationField, LocationWidget, LocationFormMixin) wired into the sample forms, plus the sample page's location card with elevation and uncertainty. The screens were prototyped and approved by the maintainer: the approved templates are on this branch and are KEPT (fairdm/contrib/location/templates/location/widgets/location.html, fairdm/templates/cotton/card/location.html, the location blocks of sample_overview.html and measurement_overview.html). The prototype's Python was set aside in the last commit (git show HEAD~1..HEAD and `git log -3` show it; `git show aed97942 -- fairdm/contrib/location/forms.py` holds the prototype field and widget for reference) — rewrite it test first, do not restore it wholesale. The widget template expects context keys widget.full, widget.parts (srid, first, second, elevation, uncertainty subwidgets by name) and widget.systems; per plan D3 the systems list must come from the server (code, name, geographic) via json_script rather than the script's hard-coded list.
plan_sections: D7 (card, sample overview, location page removal, admin)
prior_decisions: D1: a location is a value on each record, never a shared row. No Location model, no get_or_create.
D2: Organization holds a plain point, a Person holds none. Contributor.location is removed.
D8: no data migration — existing Point data is not carried across.

D11: coordinates are read with lat-lon-parser 1.3.1; the field adds the range check, the hemisphere-belongs-to-axis check, and refuses minutes written with the letter m (the package reads a trailing s after seconds as south: '48d 56m 7s' -> -48.935).
D12: field names are location, location_elevation, location_uncertainty.

D13: geometry column in SRID 4326; distance lookups (US2) cast to geography. In US1 declare the GistIndex on Cast('location', PointField(geography=True)) in each model's own Meta.indexes (Sample, Measurement, and Organization), because Sample.Meta and Measurement.Meta already declare indexes and would drop an inherited list. Index names <= 30 chars: sample_location_geog_idx, measurement_location_geog_idx, organization_location_geog_idx.
D15/ARCH-008: a foreign key becoming a point under the same name is written as RemoveField then AddField, never AlterField.

FR-009: a sample type shows the location input only when its registration's fields list location. The demo's RockSample registration is to list location (as the approved prototype did); WaterSample does not.
The admin stays on plain ModelAdmin (no GISModelAdmin). Remove location from SampleAdmin.autocomplete_fields.

acceptance.given_when_then: Given text in decimal degrees, degrees+decimal minutes, or DMS, with symbols or spaces and a hemisphere letter or word before or after, when parse_coordinate reads it for its axis, then all forms of one place agree within 1e-5 degrees; out-of-range values, a hemisphere of the other axis, minutes written with m, and unreadable text are refused with a ValidationError.

Given a full LocationField, when it cleans 4326 degrees, 25832 northing/easting, an unknown code, one coordinate only, elevation/uncertainty without coordinates, a negative uncertainty, or a projected point outside WGS84, then it returns the right SRID-4326 point (within 1 m of GDAL's conversion) or refuses with a message; all-empty cleans to None; the point-only field takes only two coordinates in WGS84; decompress gives decimal degrees back.

Given the model, when an elevation or uncertainty is saved without a location, or a negative uncertainty, then the database refuses it; two samples at the same coordinates change independently; clearing the location through the form clears elevation and uncertainty.

Given a sample type listing location, when its edit page is posted with coordinates in each notation and in a projected system, then the sample is saved with the WGS84 point; each FR-008 case is refused without saving; a type not listing location has no location field.
Given a sample with a location, elevation and uncertainty, when its page is opened, then latitude and longitude appear to five decimal places with the elevation and uncertainty.
lat-lon-parser in pyproject and uv.lock; LocatedRecord applied; migrations apply from empty (tests/test_smoke.py green) and makemigrations --check is clean.
The input classes exist as plan D3 describes and the approved widget template renders from them.

No module, setting, template or test refers to Point, PointFactory, fairdm_location.Point, FAIRDM_CRS, FAIRDM_X_COORD or FAIRDM_Y_COORD (the changelog excepted); every test that used them now passes a GEOS point and keeps what it asserts; tests/test_contrib/test_location/test_views.py is deleted with the page.
The card takes elevation and uncertainty and the sample overview passes the three fields.

docs/portal-development/locations.md exists, is in a toctree, and documents the fields and the input with examples that run; CONTEXT.md defines Location and Reference system; CHANGELOG lists the new fields and every removal; FS-005's spec text matches.
